user_instruction: Do not ask questions. User will not play audio into the Pi. Quiet recording is authorized to verify the stream. Pi changes and allowance adjustments are authorized; back up as work progresses.
supersedes: Earlier fresh-readiness requirements for quiet microphone checks, and earlier per-change approval assumptions for task-relevant Pi/resource work. Prior receipts and admissions remain unchanged.
quiet_capture_scope: Bounded stream continuity, timestamps, rate/channel mapping, ring/input faults, PCM save/reopen, model passage and resource/lifecycle checks with quiet/background input. Quiet is expected, not guaranteed exact zero or labelled acoustic truth.
spoken_or_noisy_quality_validation: Deferred; do not solicit speech or playback from the user, and do not infer speech/restaurant quality from quiet recordings.
backup_requirement: Versioned copies/hashes of affected code/config and model manifests, documented restore/activation path, preserved original baseline and personal data. Reviewed small code/docs backed up to verified Git refs; audio/transcripts/vectors/weights/credentials stay private.
resource_practice: Keep concrete bounded runs and measured headroom. Initial 3 GiB file policy remains until a documented change is useful; no unlimited jobs. Record actual applied limits and live service properties before exit.
pi_gui_scope: Task-relevant on-device GUI testing may proceed; distinguish visible rendering, withdrawn widget tests and actual physical touch evidence. Do not take over Windows desktop/input.
